[[File:Jedi_symbol.svg|thumb|right|250px|]]

A '''crest''' was the emblem of the [[Jedi Order]]. It was similar to the emblem used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="A Test of Strength Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/a-test-of-strength-trivia-gallery|text="A Test of Strength" Trivia Gallery}}</ref>

The emblem existed at least as early as [[115 BBY]], appearing on the cover of the third edition of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> By [[22 BBY]], it was widely used on [[Jedi armor]] worn during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==

[[File:Era-leg.png|thumb|right|The symbol of the [[Legacy era]].]]

According to a [[2006]] blog post by [[Leland Chee]], the "Jedi logo" was originally created for use in real-world merchandise. It appeared for the first time as an in-universe emblem in [[2004]]'s ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'',<ref name="KotHB">{{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}</ref> identifying the [[Jedi Order]] as a manufacturer.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', "Major Manufacturers"</ref>

The symbol was later used to represent the [[Legacy era]] in publishing, starting with the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series of novels, and was also used without a surrounding circle to denote the Jedi Order in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|The Clone Wars]]'' film and television series.<ref name="TCW" />

In the later [[Canon]] continuity, the symbol would continue to be used to represent the Jedi Order. It made its first appearance in a numbered ''[[Star Wars]]'' film within one of the [[sacred Jedi texts]] in [[2017]]'s {{Film|VIII}}.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi">{{Film|VIII}}</ref><ref name="SW-Inside the Lucasfilm Archive: The Jedi Texts">{{SW|url=news/inside-the-lucasfilm-archives-the-jedi-texts|text=Inside the Lucasfilm Archive: The Jedi Texts}}</ref>
